name: Aoyagi Miyako
source: Shinji's girlfriend and the daughter of Yoshino and Iwao. She is considered to be one of the beauties of the school. She confessed to Shinji and started dating for six months. Miyako wishes to be with Shinji, much to Yoshino's disapproval who wishes for her to focus on her piano studies.
